title: albemarle names bhp executive ragnar udd ceo 2026 09 03
text:
Sept 3 (Reuters) - Albemarle (ALB.N)
, opens new tab
 said ​on Thursday it has appointed BHP (BHP.AX)
, opens new tab
 ‌executive Ragnar Udd as its CEO, tapping an industry veteran to lead the world's ​largest lithium producer.
Udd, currently BHP's chief ​commercial officer, will take on the ⁠new role on February 1, 2027, ​replacing Kent Masters.
The appointment comes after BHP's internal ​memo showed Udd would leave the mining giant at the end of January to pursue a ​new opportunity.
At BHP, Udd has overseen ​global sales and marketing, procurement, maritime activities and ‌commodities-market ⁠strategy. He previously led BHP's Americas business, including its copper and potash operations.
Masters, who has led Albemarle since April 2020, ​will become ​executive ⁠chairman and remain in that role through the company's 2027 ​annual shareholder meeting, after which the ​board ⁠will review his position annually.
He previously served as the company's lead independent director.
Shares ⁠of ​the company were down ​2.3% in premarket trading.
